summary.intent: Add test coverage for the `purgeExpired` method in `client.ts` to close a Codecov coverage gap, and resolve two open PR review threads.
summary.outcome: Both PR threads were resolved and 4 new `purgeExpired` tests were added to `client-extended.test.ts`, bringing the suite to 26 passing tests. Changes were committed and pushed.

repo: cipher-box SDK tests are split across multiple files; `client-extended.test.ts` covers extended client functionality including bin operations.
Integration tests in `integration.test.ts` have pre-existing failures unrelated to unit test work — these should not be confused with regressions.

code.finding: The mock object required a `purgeExpiredEntries` entry before tests for `purgeExpired` could be written; new tests were added after the existing `emptyBin` test block.

workflow: When test failures appear after adding new tests, isolate by running only the target test file to distinguish new failures from pre-existing ones.
Codecov coverage gaps can be traced to specific uncovered methods; grepping for the method name across test files is an effective first step.

friction: Pre-existing failures in `integration.test.ts` created noise when running the full test suite, requiring an extra targeted run to confirm new tests passed.
open_items: Pre-existing failures in `integration.test.ts` were not addressed and remain outstanding.
